text:

subject: Sports AI - Athlete performance
text:
Hi [NAME],

Thanks for checking out Encord. I wanted to reach out personally and share
a bit more context.

We work with sports tech teams like Hudl, SwingVision, and Spiideo - a
common problem we help them solve isn't a lack of video - it's that 95% of
footages are not useful until it's curated and labeled.

Encord helps performance science teams search, filter, and label training
footages at scale - so you're building models on the moments that matter.

Worth a 20-min call? Pretty flexible next Tue to Thu mornings PT.

subject: [COMPANY] is outgrowing Roboflow
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw the 2.0 launch and that you're hiring Head of ML and CV engineers.
This tells me the blueprint models are about to get a lot more complex.

Roboflow works well for getting from 0 to 1, but teams at your stage hit
ceilings around QA workflows, complex per-trade ontologies, and surfacing
edge cases across messy real-world data at scale.

OnsiteIQ and Tractable both made that transition with Encord. Structured
review pipelines, data curation that surfaces the failure modes that
matter, and ontology depth that doesn't break when you add a new trade.

Open to a quick 15-min chat? The following times work for me:

*Thursday 9th April *- 10am
*Friday 10th April* - 9:30am
*Monday 13th April* - 10am (have put in a tentative placeholder for this
time, but feel free to reschedule if needed)
